mostWorthwhile.text: Processing and exporting the collagen was most worthwhile: the panels connected protein production inside a cell to supporting fibers outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the spreading cells was a predictable final step, especially with only one combination offered, though it brought the repair together.

surprise.text: I expected the surface to need another separate step for its protective layer, but it closed with renewed layers while deeper remodeling continued.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary. The offered partners and picture descriptions gave each combination a purpose, although the menu supplied compatibility rather than leaving it to discover.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it explored a new body process. The connection between cell work and tissue repair held my interest, though several later choices were predictable.
